'''Olsini Turpo, Tailor and Haberdasher''' was a business operating in the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It provided citizens with new clothes for receptions. The business was owned by the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Olsini Turpo]].
